spreadFive.source: peso minus UR zero rate at midpoint 5.5 years (bp), outputs.curves

spreadLast.source: peso minus UR zero rate at the last midpoint (bp)

spreadFirst.source: peso minus UR zero rate at the first midpoint (bp)

dfRatioFive.source: exp(-(r_clp - r_ur) t) at 5.5 years, Annex 1 midpoint

sizeRatio.source: parallel size of the peso over the UR row of the Hoja 9 table (engine shock_table)

weightFive.source: size ratio times exp(-(r_clp - r_ur) t) at 5.5 years

tStarLo.source: midpoint of the last bucket whose first-order weight is at least 1

tStarHi.source: midpoint of the first bucket whose first-order weight is below 1

repNuLng.source: experiments/reproduce.json variants.long-uf.net_uf_share_tier1 (percent of Tier 1, absolute value)

repNuSht.source: experiments/reproduce.json variants.short-uf.net_uf_share_tier1 (percent of Tier 1, absolute value)

repNuCpi.source: experiments/reproduce.json variants.cpi-surprise.net_uf_share_tier1 (percent of Tier 1, absolute value)

repNuStp.source: experiments/reproduce.json variants.clp-steepener.net_uf_share_tier1 (percent of Tier 1, absolute value)

repNuOff.source: experiments/reproduce.json variants.offset-on-off.net_uf_share_tier1 (percent of Tier 1, absolute value)

repNuFlr.source: experiments/reproduce.json variants.floors-active.net_uf_share_tier1 (percent of Tier 1, absolute value)

repRatioLo.source: min over long-uf, short-uf, offset-on-off of ratio_nii_annex_over_single

repEveShortLo.source: min over the same of eve_shortfall_single_percent, rounded

repChargeOverTier.source: charge over Tier 1 in the short-uf variant (percent)

repChargeShareLo.source: min charge share, the three 30 percent variants

repChargeShareHi.source: max charge share, the three 30 percent variants

floorBreakNu.source: 0.05 over 0.025: the net UF position over Tier 1 at which the charge alone reaches the 5 percent line

mainChargeShareLo.source: min over the three 30 percent variants of charge_share_of_nii.mean, rounded to the percent

mainChargeShareHi.source: max over the same, rounded to the percent

pairShareEveLng.source: experiments/main.json variants.long-uf: pair-rule Shapley value of the delta EVE over (Annex 1 minus single-currency mean delta EVE), percent

pairShareEveSht.source: experiments/main.json variants.short-uf: pair-rule Shapley value of the delta EVE over (Annex 1 minus single-currency mean delta EVE), percent

pairShareEveOff.source: experiments/main.json variants.offset-on-off: pair-rule Shapley value of the delta EVE over (Annex 1 minus single-currency mean delta EVE), percent

mainEveShortLo.source: min over the three 30 percent variants of eve_shortfall_single_percent.mean

sweepGridHi.source: experiments/sweep.json max of grid (percent of Tier 1): the top of the range tested

sweepMaxAnnexNii.source: experiments/sweep.json max over positions of annex_nii_over_tier1.mean (percent)

sweepNiiFlagTotal.source: experiments/sweep.json sum over positions of annex1 nii-tier1 flag counts

sweepMarginFlagTotal.source: experiments/sweep.json sum over positions of annex1 nii-margin flag counts

sweepPosFlagFirst.source: experiments/sweep.json first position at which positive parts flag a book (percent)

floorsTotalNii.source: experiments/floors.json h5.checked halved: the comparisons of the delta NII alone (h5.checked counts both measures); every raise is on the delta NII

floorsEveEffMax.source: experiments/floors.json max absolute mean eve_effect over every cell

floorsEveChanged.source: experiments/floors.json books where the floor changes delta EVE, summed

floorsRaiseTotalFlr.source: experiments/floors.json floors-active raises summed over translations

floorsLowerTotalFlr.source: experiments/floors.json floors-active lowers summed over translations

floorsLowerOthers.source: experiments/floors.json lowers in the five other variants, summed

totalSeconds.source: sum of the five measured run times
